identity.original_title: Defender of the Crown: The Legend Returns

hooks.text: 征服领土、募集军队并攻打城堡，通过战略行动改变中世纪权力格局。
hooks.excerpt: Conquer territories, raise armies, storm castles, and shift the balance of power.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 复古模式近乎原样保留Amiga经典，经典模式则以新视觉、改良机制和流畅系统重新诠释。
hooks.excerpt: Retro Mode . The original Amiga classic, preserved with near-perfect authenticity and quality-of-life enhancements. Classic Mode. Amiga classic reimagined for today. A completely new visual identity, refined mechanics, and smoother systems.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 王国模式加入程序生成地图、特殊骰子、可解锁能力和多档难度，让每轮保持不可预测。
hooks.excerpt: Kingdom Mode. An entirely new challenge. Procedurally generated maps, special dice mechanics, unlockable abilities, and multiple difficulty levels to keep every run unpredictable.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
